<thought>We need to provide a single JSON string that describes the complete resistor network by merging the four subnetworks. The subnet data already give resistor values and connections for subnets 1, 2, and 4. Subnet 3 only supplies a single resistor value (5.0 Ω); we include it as an additional resistor with a unique identifier. To avoid identifier clashes we prefix each resistor ID with the subnet number. All connections are simply concatenated in the order they appear in the original subnet descriptions.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors":{"S1_R1":2.222,"S1_R2":4.445,"S2_R1":5.0,"S2_R2":8.889,"S2_R3":4.444,"S3_R1":5.0,"S4_R1":20.0,"S4_R2":15.0,"S4_R3":10.0,"S4_R4":5.0},"connections":[["A","N1","S1_R1"],["N1","X1","S1_R2"],["X1","N_b1","S2_R1"],["N_b1","M","S2_R2"],["M","X2","S2_R3"],["B","N_d3","S4_R1"],["N_d3","N_d2","S4_R2"],["N_d2","N_d1","S4_R3"],["N_d1","X3","S4_R4"]]}
